claim_text: There's a tear on the front of the shirt, it came like this.

_dev.why: AI fake is subtle/plausible-looking on its own (Visual signal borderline), but new-account + early-claim behaviour pushes the combined score up. C2PA STRIPPED so it is not trivially caught.

_dev.why: real shatter looks dramatic/suspicious, but glass genuinely shatters this way and the account is clean — proves the system is calibrated, not trigger-happy
